notes.title: New name: Move Meditation
notes.content: Also has some new graphics. Check it out!

notes.title: New Qigong sequence
notes.content: Also the qigong sequence is in the order of the TCM Creation Cycle.

notes.title: Has a new Introduction Button
notes.content: Also the music is different, which may please more people.

notes.title: New menu
notes.content: The music is better, too.

notes.title: New Meditation Descriptions
notes.content: This makes each meditation more meaningful.

notes.title: Better Menu
notes.content: The Meditation types are: Affirmation, Centering, Qigong, Stretching, Standing, and Decisions.

notes.title: New Internal Name: Multi Meditation
notes.content: This app has some new text treatments and starts with different options set than it did before.

notes.title: Maybe Meditation new internal name.
notes.content: The wave-like background has three frequencies: high, middle, and low

notes.title: New Internal name! Yes No Meditation
notes.content: Get Yes No Answers and also move your body and meditate! (The Yes No Answers are random or come from the Spirit World.)

notes.title: Has a new quote
notes.content:
The new quote for this app is:
Buddhists do not speak ill of others; nor do they take what is not given.

notes.title: Describes the Mind as a Rose
notes.content: Helps you focus on the goals of Universe study.

notes.title: New internal Name 1 Week Meditation
notes.content: Has affirmations and postures.

notes.title: More Affirmations
notes.content: The music is softer and it has more affirmations.

notes.title: New Music
notes.content: Also displays the principles in a way that is faster to read.

notes.title: Has more Wisdom Statements
notes.content: Life is Suffering, Suffering is Caused by Desire, said the Buddha

notes.title: New Music
notes.content: The Waltz music helps you move from activity to activity... It helps the flow of the app experience...

notes.title: Now called 1hr Meditation
notes.content: Now it has a new name and some other new features.

notes.title: New Affirmations
notes.content: Even more interesting now.

notes.title: Displays the quotes.
notes.content: Every 20 seconds, a Wisdom Quote is displayed.

notes.title: Better graphics
notes.content: The music is now a Blues selection. The graphics are less dark and more calming.

notes.title: Has More Wisdom Messages
notes.content: This update has more wisdom statements and they play every 20 seconds by default.

notes.title: Update has Yoga postures.
notes.content: Shows some healing Yoga postures as well with the regular information.

notes.title: Many Good Improvements.
notes.content: Has many improvements to your meditation experience.
